headline: Sensex Surpasses 81,000 and Nifty Reclaims 25,000 as PSU Banks Lead Market Recovery

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: PSU banking stocks rallied 1.5% with lenders leading the gains
A correction in global oil prices provided support to Indian equities
Nifty reclaimed the 25,000 level following a recovery from the Muhurat trading dip
Broader markets showed signs of pausing after a significant six-day bull run
whatHappening: Sensex surpassed the 81,000 milestone while Nifty settled above 25,000
Markets initially slipped into the red due to profit-taking before recovering
Data Patterns witnessed a sharp rise of 9% in today's session
NSE and BSE will be closed on November 10 for the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday
summary: Indian markets ended higher as Sensex crossed 81,000 and Nifty reclaimed 25,000, driven by a rally in PSU banks. Despite early volatility and profit-taking after a six-day bull run, indices managed to close in the green. Markets will remain closed tomorrow, November 10, in observance of Diwali-Balipratipada.
